title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Have someone else handle the paperwork and filing. But if you need anyone dealt with, or protected, just give me the list of names. I'll take care of them.

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Have someone else handle the paperwork and filing. But if you need anyone dealt with, or protected, just give me the list of names and I will go.

title: Talk 1
original: These are clothes and snacks for Lisa, along with gifts for her friends. As for this box of old books her papa insisted I bring, I'm not sure what they're for. I'll just let Lisa decide what to do with them.

title: Talk 1
original: These are clothes and snacks for Lisa, and these are some gifts I prepared for her friends. As for this box of old books her papa insisted I bring, I'm not sure what they're for. I'll just let my daughter handle it herself, once she's here.

title: Talk 2
original: Uniform? No, thanks. I don't know why you people need so many pockets. Just as I can't grasp why the Higashinese stuff planks and pillows in their waistbands, making it so terribly hard to move around… Anyway, I'm fine with this outfit, and it has nothing to do with me being Siracusan.

title: Talk 2
original: Uniform? No, grazie. I don't understand why you people need so many pockets, just as I can't grasp why the Higashinese love stuffing planks and pillows into their waists, making it so terribly hard to move around... I'm comfortable in this outfit, and it has nothing to do with me being Siracusan.

title: Talk 3
original: Some of the operators here have unsteady breathing. Perhaps they could try reciting a tanka or two to adjust their breaths as they strike, like: 'Solitude seeps not from autumn shade, but from the mountain pines in red sun's fall.' Or 'I bear no off'ring branch unto the hills, for rich brocades of maple sate the gods.' You think these lines evoke a particular image? Hm. Probably.

title: Talk 3
original: You have some nervous Operators here. Perhaps they could try reciting a haiku or two to pace their breaths. Like 'Solitude seeps not from autumn's shade, but from the mountain pines in red sun's fall.' Or 'I bear no off'ring branch unto the hills, for rich brocades of maple sate the gods.'—these poems evoke a particular image? Hm. I suppose.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: No need to hide the Wolumonde story from me. Hm, you look nervous, but I'm not here to cast blame, my daughter knows the meaning of her work. Suzuran is no fragile flower, and I am no hidebound gardener.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: No need to hide the Wolumonde story from me... You look nervous, but I'm not here to cast blame, my daughter knows her work is meaningful. The Suzuran is no fragile flower, and I am no old-fashioned gardener.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My return trip to Siracusa? The perpetrator is dead, so there is little else to say. The man who, in his lust for power, deprived so many of a decent life, did not deserve a decent death.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: How was my return trip to Siracusa, you ask? The guilty party is dead, so there is little else to say. How could one who made so many suffer on a quest for power die with honor?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Lost in thought? Is something wrong? Hm, some business less suited to a so-called pharmaceutical company, is it? If you need my help, do speak clearly now. You see, Doctor, I have only the patience to manage this single braid.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Why are you staring so emptily? Is something bothering you? Perhaps some work less suited to a so-called pharmaceutical company? If I can be of help, then speak, Doctor... My patience will last only until I finish this braid.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: The wine tasting is already finished? I went to freshen up and hurried back as quickly as I could... Ah, sorry, but my work demands it. You see, precision is everything. I must be meticulous about which bastard die at which moment, not a second sooner. Hehe, but we don't need to pick a time for whiskey. Care to stay a while longer?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: The wine tasting is already finished? I went to fix my suit and hurried back as quick as I could... Ah, scusa. I forgot to look at my watch. My work requires careful timekeeping—there is a method behind the timing at which the bastardi die. But why not stay a while? Whiskey is a fine drink, special occasion or no.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: So much snow on the deck, and yet the corridors are not cold. I detest inconsistent weather, so the landship has been a blessing. I only just realized how long I've been here. You're right, an assassin's vacation is a good thing, for herself, and others.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: So much snow on the deck, and yet the corridors are not cold. I detest inconsistent weather, so the landship has been a blessing—I only just realized how long I've been here. You're right: An assassin's vacation is a good thing, for herself, and others.

title: Idle
original: I'll stay here, just call me if you need something. Hard to believe? Sometimes, I can be very patient, Doctor. Have you ever tried combing nineteen tails in one go?

title: Idle
original: I'm over here, just call me if you need something... I am a very patient woman, Doctor. Did you ever try combing nineteen tails in one go?

title: Onboard
original: Hello. You must be 'the incredible Doctor' Lisa always mentions in her letters. Hmm, I've been curious to know what you looked like, and here you are. Which reminds me, could you update me on Lisa's studies, if you have the time?

title: Onboard
original: Ciao. I've always been curious what 'the incredible Doctor' Lisa always mentioned in her letters looked like... heh. And here you are. Could you update me on her schooling? If you have the time?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: It's not often I see recordings of myself. I fought my battles in quiet alleyways, with no witnesses.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: It's not often I see recordings of myself. I fought my battles in quiet alleyways, with no witnesses.

title: Promotion 1
original: I appreciate the recognition. But this means those after the bounty on my head will come looking for Rhodes Island. You are not worried?

title: Promotion 1
original: I appreciate the recognition. But this means those after the bounty on my head will come looking for Rhodes Island. You are not worried?

title: Promotion 2
original: I accept your medal, Doctor. You needn't say more. I do know the difference between this medal, and the emblems of the Siracusan family.

title: Promotion 2
original: I accept your medal, Doctor. But enough talk, I do know the difference between this decoration and the emblems of the Siracusan famiglie.

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the toughest one for me.

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the toughest one for me.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Just keep yourselves safe, ladies and gentlemen.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Just keep yourselves safe.

title: Depart
original: My ears are sharp, so when I stop, you stop.

title: Depart
original: My ears are sharp, so when I stop, you stop.

title: Begin Operation
original: Need to parley with them? But I rarely do such things, whether I'm in Siracusa or Higashi.

title: Begin Operation
original: You want to parley? A rare business for me, whether in Siracusa or Higashi.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm all ears.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm all ears. Speak.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: So much negotiation and we end up talking with our blades.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: So much negotiation and we end up talking with our blades.

title: Deployment 1
original: Splendid day today.

title: Deployment 1
original: Fa bel tempo.

title: Deployment 2
original: Beautiful place.

title: Deployment 2
original: Posto bellissimo.

title: In Battle 1
original: Hate and resentment have no place, but in a burst of autumn red.

title: In Battle 1
original: Hate and resentment have no place, but in a burst of autumn red.

title: In Battle 2
original: Flowers imbibed, the lady in suit and tie dance with her blade.

title: In Battle 2
original: Flowers imbibed, the woman in suit and tie—a dance with her blade.

title: In Battle 3
original: At least make me lose the coat.

title: In Battle 3
original: Try getting my coat off first.

title: In Battle 4
original: Why the rush? The road to the afterlife is crowded enough.

title: In Battle 4
original: Why the rush? The road to hell is crowded enough.

title: 4-star Result
original: Higashinese shoji screens often run a common theme. The kami created life and land to propagate themselves… A pity they didn't care for what came after. Sorting out this mess is hard work.

title: 4-star Result
original: Higashinese shoji screens often run a common theme. The kami created life and land to propagate themselves... a pity they didn't care for what came next. Sorting out this mess is hard work.

title: 3-star Result
original: There's nothing to clean up. Let's go.

title: 3-star Result
original: There's nothing to clean up. Let's go.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Crawling out of the swamp is hard enough, never mind doing it gracefully.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: It's not easy to pull yourself out of the mud, but there is no need to stay serious all the time.

title: Operation Failure
original: Leave the rest to me... it's clear why we failed, and I know how to make it even.

title: Operation Failure
original: Leave the rest to me... it's clear why we failed, and I know how to make it even.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: The soundproofing of this place is excellent. Was it done for professional reasons?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: The soundproofing is excellent. Was it done for professional reasons?

title: Tap
original: Hehe, even Lisa has grown out of this by now.

title: Tap
original: Huh? Even Lisa has grown out of this by now.

title: Trust Tap
original: The scar on my face? I wasn't born with it... Let's just leave it at that.

title: Trust Tap
original: The scar on my face? I wasn't born with it... no, never mind.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year. What a wonderful gathering. Dancing, chatting, making noise just for fun, instead of drowning out a struggle. Hmm… Lisa's making her way here, Doctor. That was sake in my cup and not a double whiskey shot, understand?

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year. What a wonderful gathering. Dancing, chatting, making noise for a reason other than muffling troublesome movements —Lisa's making her way here, Doctor. That was sake in my cup and not a double whiskey shot, correct?

title: Greeting
original: Hello, Doctor... Hehe, I can hear your footsteps even with my ears folded.

title: Greeting
original: Ciao, Doctor... I can hear your footsteps even with folded ears, you know.

title: Birthday
original: Happy Birthday, Doctor. Lisa's papa asked me to give you this omamori. He hopes to visit you in person, if given the chance. As for me, I offer a promise: my blade is yours whenever you need it.

title: Birthday
original: Buon compleanno, Doctor. Lisa's papa asked me to give you this omamori. He hopes to visit you in person, if given the chance. As for me, I offer a promise: call my name anytime you need my blade.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I first contacted Rhodes Island because it was the best place to treat Lisa. But now, I would send her here to learn, even if she were perfectly healthy. Do not let this landship ever stop, Doctor, not after it has been sailing for so long.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I contacted Rhodes Island in the first place because it was the most suitable place to treat Lisa. But now, I would send her here to learn, even if she was cured. Do not let this landship ever stop, Doctor, not after it has been sailing for so long.
